_comment: Meta-progression (ROGUELITE_REWORK sections 9 and 17). Every XP number and the level curve come from the formulas below; docs/design/PROGRESSION.md prints the resulting tables and the reasoning. XP is banked the instant it is earned. Levels are computed from total XP, never stored, so changing a number here re-levels every profile. Unlocks widen options and never raise numbers (Second Wake is the one sanctioned bend). All values are playtest hypotheses.

deed_base._comment: XP for a deed = deed_base[id] x band_multiplier[band of the site it happened at]. Three sizes: 5 for tidying up, 10 for an act, 30 for a fight won. Anything unlisted pays `default`.

band_multiplier._comment: Risk pays: the same act is worth band x as much, because distance and danger are the cost (WORLD_MAP_PLAN bands). A deed with no band counts as band 1.

event_xp._comment: Flat, because none of these has a band. `banked_unit` is per unit of sortie loot deposited at the Throne; `relic_banked` per relic.

run_end_xp._comment: Paid once when the run ends, however it ends. `per_day` is per full game day survived.

level_curve._comment: Going from level L to L+1 costs step x L XP, so level L needs step x L x (L-1) / 2 in total: 100, 300, 600, 1000, 1500 ... Each level costs one more step than the last.

unlocks.name: Second Wake
unlocks.description: Once per run, death still costs everything he carries -- but he wakes at the Throne instead of the run ending.

unlocks.name: A second carried relic
unlocks.description: Take two items from the Lair into a run. Carried items work from the first step -- and are lost for good if he dies.

unlocks.name: A third carried relic
unlocks.description: Take three items from the Lair into a run -- the most there will ever be (ROGUELITE_REWORK section 10).
